question: What is the meaning of environmental benefits that result from measurably improving the quality of resources in relation to environmental benefits?
data_point: environmental benefits that result from measurably improving the quality of resources
description: Environmental benefits that result from measurably improving the quality of resources refer to the positive impact on the environment achieved by enhancing the properties of materials used in products. This improvement can lead to better air and water quality, increased renewable energy supply, and safer reuse of pollutants as resources. These benefits are part of the environmental benefits outlined in ISO 59040:2025, which aim to support sustainable practices and reduce the environmental footprint of products and their value chains.
